_: 見比べ帳のコメント（例の名前 → { ja, en }）。問題のある例に、原因・処置・残りを添える（台帳 §8 と対・2026-09-30 本人「問題がある時はコメントを添えて」）。gallery.html の HTML 覗き窓に英日で載る（2026-09-30 本人「Note もそちらに英語と日本語で」）

add-a-3d-model-with-babylonjs.ja: 本物の側が描けない：babylon は毎フレーム 32 回 draw を出すが直後に GL_INVALID_OPERATION＝MapLibre と GL の状態を共有する時の食い違い（材質・行列は正常）。こちらは別 canvas に描くので皿 2 基が出る。分母の外（REF_BROKEN）。
add-a-3d-model-with-babylonjs.en: The reference side draws nothing: Babylon issues 32 draw calls per frame but each ends in GL_INVALID_OPERATION — a mismatch when sharing GL state with MapLibre (materials and matrices are fine). ortho-earth renders custom layers on a separate canvas, so both antennas appear. Excluded from the denominator (reference broken).

toggle-deckgl-layer.ja: 本物の側が読めない：style の API キーが Referer https://maplibre.org/ に縛られ、この走らせ台では両側 401（curl で確認）。こちらは既定の基図に落ち、deck.gl の overlay（5 点）は描ける。分母の外（REF_BROKEN）。
toggle-deckgl-layer.en: The reference side cannot load its style: the API key is locked to Referer https://maplibre.org/, so both sides get 401 on this rig (verified with curl). ortho-earth falls back to its default basemap and the deck.gl overlay (5 points) draws. Excluded from the denominator (reference broken).

sync-movement-of-multiple-maps.ja: 3 枚とも生きて連動（段 2〜3＝撮る時に動いているかで揺れる）。本物の例外（unpkg の CommonJS プラグインの module is not defined）は害なし＝両側同じ例外は落ちに数えない。通訳の live な Map は 1 頁 4 枚まで（2026-09-30 本人裁定・旧 2）＝3 枚とも生きて連動する。見た目＝本物はメルカトル 3 分割・こちらは球 3 つ（文書の違い）。
sync-movement-of-multiple-maps.en: All three maps are live and synchronized. The exception thrown on the reference side (the CommonJS plugin from unpkg: module is not defined) is harmless and identical on both sides, so it is not counted. ortho-earth allows up to four live maps per page. Visually, MapLibre shows three Mercator panes; ortho-earth shows three globes — a documented difference.

add-a-custom-layer-with-tiles-to-a-globe.ja: 直した：custom 層に球の variant（例が setProjection(globe) か style の projection で球を頼んだ時だけ＝メルカトルで書かれた層は従来どおり）（MapLibre の projectionGlobe と同じ関数名・極の頂点・裏側の面）＋ createTileMesh／subdivisionGranularity。基図 9→96/156。残り＝注記と経緯線の色の細部。
add-a-custom-layer-with-tiles-to-a-globe.en: Fixed: custom layers get a globe variant (only when the page asks for globe via setProjection or the style's projection; Mercator-written layers are unchanged) with the same shader function names as MapLibre's projectionGlobe, pole vertices and back-face handling, plus createTileMesh / subdivisionGranularity. Basemap probes went from 9 to 96 of 156. Remaining: fine details of labels and graticule colors.

pmtiles-source-and-protocol.ja: 直した：頁が addProtocol("pmtiles") を登録している時、基図の読み口にアーカイブの URL だけを渡していた（pmtiles.js は何も返さない）→ MapLibre と同じ pmtiles://…/{z}/{x}/{y} の形で頼む。
pmtiles-source-and-protocol.en: Fixed: when the page registers addProtocol("pmtiles"), ortho-earth used to hand the archive URL alone to the protocol (pmtiles.js returns nothing for that). It now requests pmtiles://…/{z}/{x}/{y} exactly as MapLibre does.

adding-3d-models-using-threejs-on-terrai.ja: 直した：queryTerrainElevation（同期＝標高のメモ）。残り＝基図の色（地形の上の模型の位置は標高のメモが届いた後に決まる）。
adding-3d-models-using-threejs-on-terrai.en: Fixed: queryTerrainElevation (synchronous, from the cached elevation). Remaining: basemap colors; the model's position on terrain is settled only after the elevation data arrives.

walk-around-a-map-in-first-person.ja: 直した：calculateCameraOptionsFromTo（MapLibre の式のまま）・maxZoom の既定 22（目の高さ 1.6m は z21.3＝旧はエンジンの既定で z19 に頭打ち・2026-11-02）。動く例（animated）＝段 2 まで。
walk-around-a-map-in-first-person.en: Fixed: calculateCameraOptionsFromTo (MapLibre's formula verbatim) and maxZoom defaulting to 22 (a 1.6 m eye height is z21.3; it used to stop at z19, 2026-11-02). Animated example, so level 2 is the ceiling.

set-center-point-above-ground.ja: 直した：注視点の高さ（centerClampedToGround:false＋elevation 541m）・高さ 0 の押し出しも屋根だけ描く（z13 の束ねた建物＝MapLibre の平らな面・2026-11-02）。段 1 の残り＝問い合わせ：本物は絵に建物が無い点（空・白地）でも同じ 2 棟（id 36933340・2780535862）を画面の全幅で返す＝こちらは絵どおり空を返す（2026-11-02 本人裁定＝MapLibre の答えに寄せない）。
set-center-point-above-ground.en: Fixed: the center point's elevation (centerClampedToGround:false with elevation 541 m), and zero-height extrusions now draw their flat roof like MapLibre (the merged z13 buildings, 2026-11-02). Remaining at level 1, by decision: on points where MapLibre's own picture shows no building (sky, blank ground) MapLibre still returns the same two buildings across the whole width; ortho-earth answers from what it draws and returns nothing there.

elevate-symbols-above-the-terrain.ja: 標高が正しく読めるようになり（terrarium の符号化）、街と山並みは本物と同じ構図に。残り＝細い道路と注記の標本で 8 割に届かない・記号の z 持ち上げ（symbol-z-elevate）は未実装。
elevate-symbols-above-the-terrain.en: Elevation now decodes correctly (terrarium encoding), so the town and the ridges match the reference. Remaining: probes on thin roads and labels stay under the 80% bar, and symbol-z-elevate is not implemented.

sky-fog-terrain.ja: sky（sky-color／horizon-color／fog-color／fog-ground-blend）は B4（2026-10-12）で読む＝GL2 の簡易の空と霧の色・濃さ。地平線の形と散乱は本物と同じではない。地形の起伏と陰影は本物と同じ。
sky-fog-terrain.en: sky (sky-color / horizon-color / fog-color / fog-ground-blend) is read since B4 (2026-10-12): a simple WebGL2 sky gradient plus fog color and density. The horizon shape and scattering are not identical to the reference. Terrain relief and hillshade match.

3d-terrain.ja: 地形は本物と同じ（terrarium の符号化と注視点の高さを直した）。残り＝OSM の画像タイルは両側とも Access blocked（403）＝標本は文字の上に落ちる。
3d-terrain.en: Terrain matches the reference (terrarium decoding and center elevation fixed). Remaining: the OSM raster tiles are blocked (403) on both sides, so the probes land on the placeholder text.

display-a-hybrid-satellite-map-with-terr.ja: 地形は本物と同じ。残り＝衛星画像の段の細部と注記。
display-a-hybrid-satellite-map-with-terr.en: Terrain matches the reference. Remaining: fine details of the satellite imagery levels and labels.

add-3d-terrain-from-quantized-mesh-tiles.ja: 直した：addProtocol から画像で返る標高（quantized-mesh の陰影）。残り＝setTerrain の quantized-mesh:// は worker が直に fetch する（読み口を通らない）＝起伏は既定の DEM。
add-3d-terrain-from-quantized-mesh-tiles.en: Fixed: hillshade from elevation returned as an image by addProtocol (quantized-mesh). Remaining: setTerrain with quantized-mesh:// is fetched directly by the worker (bypassing the protocol), so the relief comes from the default DEM.

jump-to-a-series-of-locations.ja: 揺れ：load の 2 秒後に別の都市へ飛ぶ例＝撮る時刻で 1 か 3 になる（単独 3・並べて 1）。
jump-to-a-series-of-locations.en: Flaky: the example jumps to another city two seconds after load, so the result depends on capture timing (same picture when run alone).

display-performance-metrics.ja: 揺れ：静止の判定（stable／moving）が回ごとに変わる。
display-performance-metrics.en: Flaky: the still/moving judgment changes from run to run.

display-a-popup-on-click.ja: 色は完全に一致（背景・水・道路）。76% で 8 割に届かないのは 1〜2px の道路の縁に落ちた標本（片側は道路・片側は地）。
display-a-popup-on-click.en: Colors match exactly (background, water, roads). It stays at 76% because some probes land on 1–2 px road edges (road on one side, ground on the other).

display-a-popup-on-hover.ja: 同上（密な道路網の標本の当たり外れ）。
display-a-popup-on-hover.en: Same as above (probe luck on a dense road network).

filter-symbols-by-text-input.ja: 色は一致・細い道路の幅がわずかに違う（sub-2px の縁の AA）。
filter-symbols-by-text-input.en: Colors match; thin roads differ slightly in width (sub-2 px edge anti-aliasing).

add-a-raster-tile-source.ja: 低ズームの球とメルカトルの見え方の差（本物は画面いっぱいのメルカトル・こちらは小さな球）＝意図した違い。地の色は白に揃えた。
add-a-raster-tile-source.en: At low zoom a globe and a Mercator map look different by design (MapLibre fills the screen with Mercator; ortho-earth shows a small globe). The ground color is white on both.

render-world-copies.ja: 球に世界の写しは無い（文書の違い）。低ズームの塗りを球の上で細分して段 3。
render-world-copies.en: The globe has no world copies (a documented difference). Low-zoom fills are subdivided on the globe; level 3.

add-a-generated-icon-to-the-map.ja: 同上（球）＋記号の下の標本。
add-a-generated-icon-to-the-map.en: Same as above (globe), plus probes under the icon.

add-an-icon-to-the-map.ja: 同上（球）＋記号の下の標本。
add-an-icon-to-the-map.en: Same as above (globe), plus probes under the icon.

generate-and-add-a-missing-icon-to-the-m.ja: 同上（球）＋記号の下の標本。
generate-and-add-a-missing-icon-to-the-m.en: Same as above (globe), plus probes under the icon.

display-a-remote-svg-symbol.ja: 同上（球・z1）＝416px の SVG が球を覆う。
display-a-remote-svg-symbol.en: Same as above (globe at z1): the 416 px SVG covers the globe.

level-of-detail-control.en: setSourceTileLodParams (maxZoomLevelsOnScreen / tileCountMaxMinimum) is read since B6 (2026-10-12) and feeds the tile-zoom rule; it is a MapLibre-specific LOD control, so the picture is compared as usual.
level-of-detail-control.ja: setSourceTileLodParams（maxZoomLevelsOnScreen／tileCountMaxMinimum）は B6（2026-10-12）で読む＝タイルの z の規則に入る。MapLibre 独自の LOD の口。

customize-the-map-transform-constrain.ja: 直した：new Map の transformConstrain を結線し、minZoom の既定 −2（z −2 で本物と同じ・2026-11-02）。setTransformCameraUpdate は B6（2026-10-12）で結線。低い z の球とメルカトルの見え方の差は意図した違い（標本が足りず絵は比べない）。
customize-the-map-transform-constrain.en: Fixed: the transformConstrain map option is wired and minZoom defaults to −2, so the map opens at z −2 like MapLibre (2026-11-02). setTransformCameraUpdate has been wired since B6 (2026-10-12). At this zoom the globe and the Mercator plane look different by design, so the picture is not compared.

add-a-canvas-source.ja: canvas source は四隅の覆い（動画と同じ口・注記の下）＝毎フレーム写す。基図の上に常に乗る（傾けた時の遮蔽は無い）。
add-a-canvas-source.en: Canvas sources are drawn as a corner-pinned overlay (same path as video, below labels), copied every frame. It always sits above the basemap (no occlusion when tilted).

add-a-cog-raster-source.ja: 直した：走らせ台の素材が Range（206）に答えず、geotiff が Request failed を投げていた（エンジンの不具合ではない・2026-11-02）。残り＝本物の写し（r7）は同じ理由で COG を読めていない＝録り直しが要る。重なり順（こちらは COG の上に道路と注記が載る）は未。
add-a-cog-raster-source.en: Fixed: the test rig's asset server ignored Range requests, so geotiff threw 'Request failed' (not an engine bug, 2026-11-02). Remaining: the MapLibre capture (r7) failed to read the COG for the same reason and must be re-recorded; draw order (roads and labels sit above the COG here) is still open.

add-a-geojson-line.ja: o1012（2026-10-12）から段 3→2（known.json は o1014 に揃えた・2026-10-22）。基図の道路名「Conzelman Road」が例の足した太線の真上に乗る（足した層の標本 4/6）。原因のコードは未追跡。
add-a-geojson-line.en: Dropped from level 3 to 2 at run o1012 (known.json aligned to o1014 on 2026-10-22). The basemap road label "Conzelman Road" now sits on top of the example's thick added line (added-layer probes 4/6). Root cause not yet traced.

navigate-the-map-with-game-like-controls.ja: 直した：maxZoom の既定 22（カメラが本物と同じ z19）・目の後ろに頂点がある壁を 3D の光線で当てる（2026-11-02）。段 1 の残り＝カメラが高い建物（60m・81m）の中にあり、本物は絵に描いていない画素でもその建物を返す＝こちらは絵どおり（2026-11-02 本人裁定＝MapLibre の答えに寄せない）。
navigate-the-map-with-game-like-controls.en: Fixed: maxZoom defaults to 22 (the camera now sits at MapLibre's z19), and walls with a vertex behind the eye are hit with a 3D ray (2026-11-02). Remaining at level 1, by decision: the camera is inside two tall buildings (60 m, 81 m) and MapLibre returns them even on pixels where it draws nothing; ortho-earth answers from what it draws.

display-html-clusters-with-custom-proper.ja: 直した：低い z のメルカトルの既定の制約（中心の緯度・z0.3 で 20°N→8.6°N）・querySourceFeatures を画面を覆うタイルの中の丸に（z0 は世界の全部・2026-11-02）。残り＝丸の数 13/12（集約の組み方の差・未追跡）。
display-html-clusters-with-custom-proper.en: Fixed: MapLibre's default Mercator constraint at low zoom (center latitude 20°N → 8.6°N at z0.3) and querySourceFeatures returning clusters in the tiles that cover the screen (all of them at z0, 2026-11-02). Remaining: 13 vs 12 cluster markers (clustering difference, not yet traced).

add-a-new-layer-below-labels.ja: 足した層（都市のピンクの塗り）は本物とほぼ同じ位置と大きさに描けていて、注記の下にも隠れていない。足した層の標本が 3 点しかなく、z4 の小さな塊の縁に落ちた 2 点が 2〜3px ずれて基図の色を拾うため、段 2 と段 3 の間を揺れる（採点の揺れ・2026-11-02）。
add-a-new-layer-below-labels.en: The added layer (pink urban fill) is drawn at nearly the same place and size as the reference and is not hidden under labels. Only 3 probes land on the added layer; 2 of them sit on the edge of small z4 blobs, so a 2–3px offset picks up the basemap colour and the grade wobbles between 2 and 3 (sampling noise, 2026-11-02).
